summary.name: Virtual House Flip
summary.one_liner: Virtual House Flip (VHF) is an AI web app and Chrome extension that redesigns photos of a home's interior, exterior, or room decor.
use_cases: Visualize a kitchen or bathroom remodel before hiring contractors
Stage a listing for real estate sales
Test flip renovation concepts as an investor
Preview redesigns on Zillow or Redfin listings while browsing
summary.what_it_does: The web app takes a photo of a room, facade, or outdoor space uploaded from a phone or desktop and generates AI design options for interior and exterior transformations. Users can slide between before and after views, save remodels, remix ideas, and share them with clients or family. A Chrome extension offers the same AI features while browsing home listings on Zillow and Redfin. The page says the styles are influenced by architects and interior designers, but it gives no detail on the underlying models.
notable: Chrome extension for Zillow and Redfin listings
Before/after slider and remix of generated designs
Covers both interior and exterior redesigns
caveats: Free Basic plan is limited to 10 remodels
Pro plan costs $27/month for unlimited remodels
Page gives no details on mobile apps or other platforms beyond web and Chrome
